meaning:
1) copper, bronze
1a) copper (made from melting copper ore)
1b) bronze (made from copper and alloy)
Aramaic equivalent: ne.chash (נְחָשׁ "bronze" H5174)

elsewhere.note: I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your sky like iron, and your soil like bronze.
He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.
He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.
“I will go before you and make the rough places smooth. I will break the doors of bronze in pieces and cut apart the bars of iron.
